name: LoRa + virtual gateway
summary: Path loss by distance and terrain; airtime and duty-cycle limits.
description: Adds the REYAX RYLR896 LoRa module and a virtual multi-SF gateway that forwards uplinks to the built-in MQTT broker (lora/<net>/<addr>/up) and sends downlinks published to …/down. A payload decoder turns `k=v` or JSON payloads into lora/<net>/<addr>/decoded. Range follows distance and terrain; airtime comes from SF/BW/CR and the region's duty-cycle limits apply.
author: Breadbox
